question.question: In question 18, $B = 135^\circ$, $c = 7$ cm, $b = 2$ cm. Explain why no triangle can be formed, referencing the sine rule and the maximum possible value of sine.
question.referenceAnswer: Applying the sine rule: $\frac{c}{\sin C} = \frac{b}{\sin B}$, so $\sin C = \frac{c \sin B}{b} = \frac{7 \sin 135^\circ}{2} \approx 2.47$. Since $\sin C > 1$, which is outside the valid range $[0,1]$, no triangle exists.
